response.sql: WITH qualified_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-'), patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) as pt_avg, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as tat_diff_avg FROM Laboratory l JOIN qualified_patients qp ON l.ID = qp.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(pt_avg) as avg_pt, AVG(tat_diff_avg) as avg_tat_diff FROM patient_averages
